entities.name: Ribosomal protein uL3
observations: Exact full-length sequence match to reviewed UniProt Q5P332 from Aromatoleum aromaticum; 214 aa, 100% identity and 100% coverage.
Primary rRNA-binding protein that binds near the 3′ end of 23S rRNA and nucleates bacterial 50S subunit assembly.
Structural constituent of the cytosolic large ribosomal subunit; participates in translation.
Forms a ribosomal protein cluster with L14 and L19.
Sequence-derived molecular weight is approximately 22.35 kDa; theoretical pI is 10.31 and predicted charge at pH 7 is +12.94.
Pfam Ribosomal_L3 domain detected at residues 67–184 with i-Evalue 1.9e-11.
Reviewed homologs report an N5-methylglutamine modification at position 153; modification of this exact sequence is annotation-supported but not experimentally established for the query sample.

entities.name: Bacterial translation
observations: uL3 contributes to 50S ribosomal subunit assembly and ribosome-mediated translation through rRNA binding and structural support.
